the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: For a groupoid scheme over a field with U = Spec(k), if the point r of R has s and t inducing isomorphisms k to kappa(r), then the translation x maps to c(r, x) is an automorphism of R carrying the identity section e to r. The proof spells the functorial argument out completely: it builds the source section a and target section b of r with the relation a s b = b, defines the translation on T-valued points with a definedness check, defines the candidate inverse using the inverse map i of the groupoid with its own definedness check, and verifies both composite chase computations collapse to the identity via the groupoid axioms and the shown relation (source lines 1342-1406)
